newsitem.title: UK: Gallaher to be valued at 2.2 bln stg - paper.
newsitem.headline: Gallaher to be valued at 2.2 bln stg - paper.

text.p: American Brands Inc's British-based tobacco business Gallaher will be valued at more than 2.2 billion stg when it is floated on the London stock exchange at the end of May, the Sunday Telegraph reported. The report, which did not cite sources, said details of the listing, originally announced last October, would be published on Wednesday. It said the shares were expected to be valued at around 320 pence each. Gallaher controls 39 percent of the British tobacco market, owning the Benson & Hedges and Silk Cut brands. The company received clearance from U.S. tax authorities for the spin-off last week.
